inferential_scope: Descriptive comparison for fixed CSTR conditions and one training seed; no significance or seed-robustness claims.

fallacy_scan.Simpson_paradox: Examined per-trajectory comparisons as well as equal-weight means; no pooling across histories. Individual exceptions are retained.
fallacy_scan.Ecological_fallacy: Claims refer to mean error over the tested trajectories, not every origin or process.
fallacy_scan.Berkson_paradox: All 12 pre-specified generated test trajectories retained; no outcome-based selection.
fallacy_scan.Collider_bias: No outcome-dependent covariate adjustment or trajectory filtering.
fallacy_scan.Base_rate_neglect: Not applicable to this continuous prediction metric; no diagnostic-classification claims.
fallacy_scan.Regression_to_mean: Windows chosen before fitting; no selection of extreme test cases for retesting.
fallacy_scan.Survivorship_bias: All 14 fits, 216 raw archives and all horizons retained; no nonfinite predictions observed.
fallacy_scan.Look_elsewhere: Six reporting steps frozen in advance; all 108 entries retained including the adverse step-5 result.
fallacy_scan.Forking_paths: No retraining or hyperparameter changes after test generation; H100 retained with pre-specified H60 reporting.
fallacy_scan.Causal_overclaim: History-dependent capacity changes explicitly reported; no pure causal history effect or universal minimum claimed.
fallacy_scan.Reverse_causality: History set before fitting; causal input chronology checked, with no future reference states supplied.
